question: Will Ethereum (ETH) close above $1,915 on August 22, 2026, as reported by CoinGecko?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the CoinGecko USD spot price of Ethereum (ETH) at 23:59 UTC on August 22, 2026 is strictly greater than $1,915.00.
- "No": Wins if the CoinGecko USD spot price of Ethereum (ETH) at 23:59 UTC on August 22, 2026 is $1,915.00 or below.
